title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 61 South Baldwin Avenue in Sierra Madre, California, as the "Louis Van Iersel Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 61 South Baldwin Avenue in Sierra Madre, California, as the "Louis Van Iersel Post Office."

summary.headline: Names a post office in Sierra Madre, California, after Louis Van Iersel.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 61 South Baldwin Avenue in Sierra Madre, California, as the "Louis Van Iersel Post Office." It is a naming measure only and does not change how the post office operates or what services it provides. The summary does not describe who Louis Van Iersel was.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 29, 2016, and the renaming took effect on that date.
